title: [Mar] Banking & finance one-liners** — ICICI Bank Board approved buying up to 2% additional stake in ICICI Prudential Life Insurance; **Cred** received final RBI payment aggregator licence; RBI fined Manappuram Finance ₹2.70 lakh (KMP compensation non-compliance); Motilal Oswal Home Finance — $100mn ADB debt-financing (NCD) for affordable housing; DEG (Germany)+Citi — $76mn co-financing to Shriram Finance; India INX Global Access IFSC + HSBC IBU (GIFT City) partnership; Doha Bank exiting India (closing Mumbai & Kochi branches after 10+ years); SEBI examining Calcutta Stock Exchange's voluntary-exit application; **Trump announced $300 billion partnership with Reliance Industries** ("America First Refining" — first major new US oil refinery in 50 years); Amrit Bharat Station Scheme — redevelopment of 1,338 railway stations.

blocks.content:
**Zone: 🟡 Light-touch throughout** (Oct 2025–Mar 2026 window)

**Standing exceptions retained at full Template A across the quarter:** RBI dividend-cap/RPT cluster (Jan→confirmed Mar), SEBI market-structure reforms (Jan), RBI April-1 cluster (Feb), RBP framework (Feb), 100% FDI insurance (Feb), EPFO UPI withdrawal (Jan), Budget 2026-27 (Feb), 16th Finance Commission (Feb), India-EU FTA (Jan→Mar), India-Germany 19 pacts (Jan), India-France 21 agreements (Feb), India AI Impact Summit (Feb), RBI Central Board/Utkarsh 3.0 (Mar), RBI CAD/BoP report (Mar), RBI inflation-target renewal (Mar), Income Tax Rules 2026 (Mar), IBC Amendment (Mar), Economic Stabilisation Fund (Mar), SEBI AIF/governance reforms (Mar), NHB/NABARD standing items (Mar), ICC Men's T20 World Cup win (Mar).

**Everything else compressed to Template B+ or the Skipped Log**, per light-touch zone rules.

**Total 🔥 HIGH-tagged items across Jan-Mar: ~70+** (broadly within the 15-20% calibration band once the full quarter is weighed together — the GDP/CPI/IIP saga and the "April 1" mega-cluster account for an outsized but justified share, given their genuine cross-month trap density).

📌 **Revise today (top 10 🔥 HIGH-tagged items across the full quarter, ranked by trap density):**

1. **The GDP/CPI/IIP/fiscal-deficit base-year saga** (Jan-Mar) — three base years, IIP trend reversal (7.8%→4.8%), fiscal deficit old-vs-revised trio

2. **The "What changes April 1, 2026" mega-cluster** — RBI/SEBI/tax/FSSAI/SWM items spanning all three months (see Section 2 running thread)

3. **RBI's dividend-payout cap (75% of PAT, CET1-linked)** — Jan announcement, March mechanism confirmation

4. **India's T20 World Cup 2026 win** — home-soil + back-to-back double-first

5. **India AI Impact Summit 2026** — MANAV Vision, 89 signatories, GPU numbers, 2027 Geneva

6. **India-EU FTA (22nd partner) vs India-France (21 pacts) vs India-Germany (19 pacts)** — three bilateral clusters, easy to mix up

7. **Hurun (308) vs Forbes (229)** — India billionaire count trap pair

8. **100% FDI in insurance (Feb)** — paired with the SBSR Act's Feb 5 in-force date (referenced again in March IRDAI approvals)

9. **PM Modi's 8,931-day longest-serving-elected-head-of-govt milestone** + Sitharaman's "9th Budget in a row"

10. **Feb 2026 monthly-data cluster**: Manufacturing PMI (56.9) / GST collections (₹1.83 lakh crore, +8.1%) / WPI (2.13%)

⚠️ **Content gaps carried forward**: No dedicated CGB PIB/Circulars sub-PDF processed for Jan, Feb, or March (consistent with your existing backlog note — ~100pp/month PIB + ~20-30pp/month Circulars still pending). No NABARD/NHB-specific standalone circular beyond the items captured here. FATF item present (March grey-list addition) but with limited direct-India-impact detail in source.

*Consolidates: "1st January to 28th February 2026" (Jan-Feb light-touch file, itself merged from CGB Mentors' Jan 169pp + Feb 121pp compilations) + "1st to 31st March 2026" (CGB Mentors March compilation). Framework v3.1 applied; light-touch zone throughout; all 11 sections processed; ruthless re-compression and duplicate-merge pass applied across the full quarter. Compiled 20 August 2026.*

items: **CPI/GDP/IIP new-series releases**: all confirmed **implemented on schedule** — CPI 12 Feb 2026, GDP 27 Feb 2026, IIP 28 May 2026.

**RBI digital-fraud compensation framework** (Feb framework + March implementing directions): finalised, but implementation **deferred twice** — now targeted **1 January 2027** (not April 2026 as originally drafted, and not July 1, 2026 as the March directions initially stated).

**RBI acquisition-financing, MSME collateral, broker-funding, ECB, RPT, NBFC risk-weight norms** (Jan and Feb April-1 clusters): effective dates have passed; **not individually re-verified** this session given volume — spot-check before flashcarding exact provisions.
**RBI UTI framework (OTC derivatives)**: still pending, deferred to 1 Jan 2027.
**RBI 2FA mandate, DigiLocker verification, ECB filing window**: effective dates (1 April 2026) reached as scheduled — implemented.
**RBI capital-market-exposure rules**: postponed deadline (1 July 2026) — not yet due as of source writing; confirm closer to your exam date.
**RBI dividend-payout cap (75% of PAT)**: effective FY27 — on track, no reversal found.
**SEBI CAS**: scheduled 3 Aug 2026 — just implemented as of this writing.
**SEBI SWAGAT-FI, demat simplification, social-media disclosure mandate**: effective dates passed — likely implemented, not individually re-verified.
**SEBI intra-day MF borrowing, IT Resilience Index, custodian SBU framework**: April 2026 and March 2026 effective dates — implemented as scheduled, no reversal found.
**Income Tax Rules 2026**: implemented as scheduled from 1 April 2026 — no reversal found.

**Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Bill**: implemented — passed Rajya Sabha 1 April 2026, Presidential assent 6 April 2026, now IBC (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 6 of 2026); specific provisions notified separately — check for the notification schedule closer to exam date.
**Ind AS 117 for insurers** and **Solid Waste Management Rules 2026**: both implemented as scheduled from 1 April 2026.
**Economic Stabilisation Fund (₹1 lakh crore)**: implemented — approved via supplementary demands + Appropriation Bill 2026.
**India-EU FTA**: concluded negotiations (26 Jan); MFN status (5 years) confirmed in March; formal signing/ratification status not independently re-verified this session.
**Kerala→Keralam rename**: Bill referred to State Assembly under Article 3 as of Feb 2026; final legislative outcome not verified this session — worth a quick check closer to exam date.
**Bain Capital-Manappuram deal**: fully resolved within this quarter — announced Feb (₹4,385 crore, 41.66% joint control), RBI clearance confirmed March. No further status check needed.
No other material changes identified for remaining flagged items within this session's search budget.
